steps.title: Name your game
steps.text: Your game's name is in the project's settings. It's also what the title screen and an exported game show.

steps.title: Change what the boat owes
steps.text: The debt is a resource. Raise its start for a longer game, lower it for a shorter one.

steps.title: Add something to find in a wreck
steps.text: Each wreck draws one event from this deck. Add an event of your own, and give it a weight.

steps.title: Reshape the coast
steps.text: The coast is made fresh each voyage from these rules. Add a layer, or change what turns up how often.

steps.title: Make the raiders tougher
steps.text: The raider's stats are what the fight's odds come from. Raise its guns, then look at the odds before you fight.

steps.title: Change a contract's pay
steps.text: A contract is a quest. Its last stage pays: change the coin, or what else it gives.

steps.title: Give the skipper more voyages
steps.text: How the game ends is the harbour script's: VOYAGES is how many voyages the harbourmaster allows.

steps.title: Recolour it
steps.text: Six colours and a type size are the whole theme. The designer checks they stay readable.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Play your changes here, and use the debug tools to jump ahead.

steps.title: Export it
steps.text: Export a web build, a single file or an itch.io zip from the Project panel.
